hook.en: Ten computers can be wired in many shapes: all to one box, in a circle, along one long cable, or each to every other. The shape changes cost, speed and what happens when something breaks.
hook.kn: ಹತ್ತು ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹಲವು ಆಕಾರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಬಹುದು: ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಒಂದು ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆಗೆ, ವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ, ಒಂದೇ ಉದ್ದ ಕೇಬಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದೂ ಉಳಿದೆಲ್ಲಕ್ಕೆ. ಆಕಾರ ವೆಚ್ಚ, ವೇಗ ಮತ್ತು ದೋಷದ ಪರಿಣಾಮವನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Describe mesh, ring, bus, star and tree topologies

narration.en: Ten computers can be wired in many shapes: all to one box, in a circle, along one long cable, or each to every other. The shape changes cost, speed and what happens when something breaks.
narration.kn: ಹತ್ತು ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹಲವು ಆಕಾರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಬಹುದು: ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಒಂದು ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆಗೆ, ವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ, ಒಂದೇ ಉದ್ದ ಕೇಬಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದೂ ಉಳಿದೆಲ್ಲಕ್ಕೆ. ಆಕಾರ ವೆಚ್ಚ, ವೇಗ ಮತ್ತು ದೋಷದ ಪರಿಣಾಮವನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Topology is the arrangement of computers and devices in a network. Mesh: each device is connected to every other device; it is very reliable and secure but needs many cables, $n(n-1)/2$ links for n nodes. Ring: each node is connected to two neighbours, forming a closed loop; data travels in one direction, so one broken link can stop the ring. Bus: all nodes are connected to one backbone cable with terminators at the ends; it is cheap, but a fault in the backbone stops the network.

points.en: Mesh: n(n−1)/2 links, very reliable, costly
Bus: one backbone cable, cheap, backbone failure is fatal

narration.en: In a mesh every device connects to every other, so it is reliable but costly. A ring is a closed loop, and a bus uses one backbone cable.
narration.kn: ಮೆಶ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಾಧನ ಉಳಿದೆಲ್ಲಕ್ಕೆ ಜೋಡಿತ; ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹ ಆದರೆ ದುಬಾರಿ. ರಿಂಗ್ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ವೃತ್ತ; ಬಸ್ ಒಂದೇ ಬೆನ್ನೆಲುಬು ಕೇಬಲ್ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Drawing the five topologies

say.en: In a bus, every node hangs off one backbone cable. It is cheap, but a break in the backbone stops the network.
In a ring, each node connects to two neighbours, and data goes round the ring.
In a star, every node connects to a central switch. One bad cable affects one node, but if the switch fails, all fail.
In a mesh, every node links to every other node. It is very reliable but needs n times n minus 1 over 2 cables.
A tree joins several star networks in a hierarchy, like the computer labs of a school.

narration.en: We draw bus, ring, star, mesh and tree topologies and count the links each needs.

body.en: Star: every node is connected to a central device, a hub or switch. It is easy to install and manage, and one faulty cable affects only one node, but if the central device fails the whole network fails. Tree (hierarchical): several star networks are connected to a common backbone, in a hierarchy; it is easy to expand, as used in large campuses.

points.en: Star: central hub/switch, easy to manage, central failure is fatal
Tree: stars joined by a backbone, easily expandable

narration.en: In a star, every node connects to a central switch. A tree joins several stars in a hierarchy, which makes it easy to expand.
narration.kn: ಸ್ಟಾರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ನೋಡ್ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸ್ವಿಚ್‌ಗೆ ಜೋಡಿತ. ಟ್ರೀ ಹಲವು ಸ್ಟಾರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ವಿಸ್ತರಿಸುವುದು ಸುಲಭ.

problem.en: A school has 4 labs, each with 20 computers on its own switch. The four switches are connected to one main cable that runs to the server room. Name the topology inside each lab and of the whole network.

steps.en: Inside each lab, every computer connects to one switch → star.
The four stars are joined through a common backbone → tree (hierarchical).
If one lab's switch fails, only that lab is affected.

points.en: Topology is the layout of a network.
Mesh needs n(n−1)/2 links and is very reliable.
points.kn: ಮೆಶ್‌ಗೆ n(n−1)/2 ಸಂಪರ್ಕಗಳು ಬೇಕು; ಬಹಳ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹ.

points.en: Bus and ring are cheap but fail when the cable or loop breaks.
points.kn: ಬಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ರಿಂಗ್ ಅಗ್ಗ; ಕೇಬಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ವೃತ್ತ ಮುರಿದರೆ ವಿಫಲ.

points.en: Star depends on the central switch; tree joins stars in a hierarchy.
points.kn: ಸ್ಟಾರ್ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸ್ವಿಚ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಲಂಬಿತ; ಟ್ರೀ ಸ್ಟಾರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Recap. Topology is the layout of a network. Mesh needs n(n−1)/2 links and is very reliable. Bus and ring are cheap but fail when the cable or loop breaks. Star depends on the central switch; tree joins stars in a hierarchy.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಟೋಪಾಲಜಿ ಎಂದರೆ ಜಾಲದ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ. ಮೆಶ್‌ಗೆ n(n−1)/2 ಸಂಪರ್ಕಗಳು ಬೇಕು; ಬಹಳ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹ. ಬಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ರಿಂಗ್ ಅಗ್ಗ; ಕೇಬಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ವೃತ್ತ ಮುರಿದರೆ ವಿಫಲ. ಸ್ಟಾರ್ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸ್ವಿಚ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಲಂಬಿತ; ಟ್ರೀ ಸ್ಟಾರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
